snippet.title: Fuser - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Harmonix is back with a whole new music rhythm game for us to enjoy. Mash up all sorts of popular hits from Old Town Road to All Star to make sure the crowd stays pumped with gameplay similar to Drop Mix.
